review:
Catch the Gold Hold and Win is a luxury cruise slot with 25 lines, a ship captain wild and scatter tickets. Three or more scatters open two free spins events.

Big Catch fills reels 2 to 4 with the same symbol for five spins, while the VIP Only party serves only mid- and high-paying symbols for eight spins. There's also a Hold and Win feature with three jackpots, triggered by filling a 3x3 grid. BGaming rates the game medium-high volatility with a 2,000x maximum. The RTP is 94.98%, on the low side. Free spins arrive about once every 209 spins. The two free spins styles keep bonuses varied.
